description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which sets up the main UI and builds a message by processing a message string, splitting it into tokens, joining them back, and capitalizing the result.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity class that manages the main screen and displays a processed message.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when activity is created; sets the layout and updates the TextView with a message.

methods.name: buildMessage
methods.description: Builds and returns a processed message string by splitting, joining, and capitalizing content.
